# Attribution

`dict.json` is derived from the following data:

- **Wiktionary** (English edition), via the [kaikki.org](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/English/)
  machine-readable dump produced by [wiktextract](https://github.com/tatuylonen/wiktextract)
  (Tatu Ylonen). Wiktionary content is licensed under
  [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) and GFDL.
  Source: https://en.wiktionary.org/
- **FrequencyWords** by Hermit Dave, `content/2018/en/en_50k.txt` (word frequencies from
  OpenSubtitles), used to select which words are included. Content licensed under
  [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
  Source: https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords

Changes: entries were filtered by word frequency, reduced to at most two Russian translations
per word or phrase, stress marks were removed, and word forms were mapped to their lemmas.

`dict.json` is distributed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
